source_text: 本次合成任务采用已验证案例 valid-tumbler-launch；各字段以该案例的公开输入为准，不追加资料外事实。

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。
核对输出满足 Create natural, compliant Xiaohongshu campaign content from verified benefits
缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。

inputs.brand_voice: warm, plain, practical; no exclamation stacking
inputs.verified_benefits: Fictional brand-confirmed facts: dishwasher safe; fits standard 02 filters; one-piece ceramic body; launch price 129 CNY. No certification claims approved.

review_checks: 缺少必填字段 audience，必须补齐后再确认。
